info.description: Quantum Corp. engages in the manufacture of computer storage devices. It provides solutions for storing and protecting information in physical, virtual, and cloud environments. Its products and services include Myriad All-Flash File and Object, StorNext File System Unified Surveillance Platform, ActiveScale Object Storage, DXi Backup Appliances, Scalar Tape Storage, CatDV Media Asset Management, and Cloud-Based Analytics. The company was founded by Joel N. Harrison and James M. McCoy in 1980 and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: Quantum Corp. 從事電腦儲存設備的製造。它提供了在實體、虛擬和雲端環境中儲存和保護資訊的解決方案。其產品和服務包括 Myriad 全快閃檔案和物件、StorNext 檔案系統統一監控平台、ActiveScale 物件儲存、DXi 備份設備、標量磁帶儲存、CatDV 媒體資產管理和基於雲端的分析。該公司由 Joel N. Harrison 和 James M. McCoy 於 1980 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the performance of the common stock of Rivian Automotive, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The fund aims to generate 2 times the daily performances of the underlying stock for a single day. A "single day" is defined as being calculated "from the close of regular trading on one trading day to the close on the next trading day."
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF 尋求 Rivian Automotive, Inc. 普通股績效每日百分比變動 2 倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化 2 倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金的目標是單日產生標的股票日表現兩倍的收益。 「單日」的定義是「從一個交易日常規交易收盤起至下一交易日收盤止」計算。

info.description: SunCar Technology Group, Inc. engages in the provision of automotive after-sales service and insurance intermediation service through its subsidiaries in the People's Republic of China. The company was founded on August 6, 2021 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: SunCar Technology Group, Inc.透過其位於中華人民共和國的子公司提供汽車售後服務和保險中介服務。公司成立於2021年8月6日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Rivian Automotive, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of category-defining electric vehicles and accessories. It operates through following segments: Automotive, Software and Services. The company was founded by Robert J. Scaringe in June 2009 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Rivian Automotive, Inc. 從事定義類別的電動車及配件的設計、開發和製造。它透過以下部門運作：汽車部門、軟體部門和服務部門。該公司由 Robert J. Scaringe 於 2009 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: REalloys, Inc. is engaged in the rebuilding of domestic supply chain resilience for rare earth elements and magnets. It is involved in recycling, mining, oxide production, metallization, alloying, and magnet manufacturing. The company was founded on October 4, 2011 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: REalloys, Inc. 致力於重建稀土元素和磁鐵的國內供應鏈彈性。它涉及回收、採礦、氧化物生產、金屬化、合金化和磁鐵製造。該公司成立於2011年10月4日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: ECARX Holdings, Inc. engages in the development of mobility technology services. The company was founded by Zi Yu Shen & Shu Fu Li in 2017 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: ECARX Holdings, Inc. 從事行動技術服務開發。該公司由沉子宇和李樹福於2017年創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Orangekloud Technology, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in providing information technology consulting services. Its digital transformation projects include the sales and consulting of Microsoft Dynamics ERP software licenses. It operates through the Packaged Software Solutions, and No-Code Platform and Mobile Application segments. The Packaged Software Solutions segment refers to packaged software and custom software solutions. The No-Code Platform and Mobile Application focuses on providing a rapid development environment through a No-Code platform. The company was founded by Kian Hwa Goh, Lay Hua Lung and Kim Chwee Chew on May 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Orangekloud Technology, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供資訊科技諮詢服務。其數位轉型專案包括 Microsoft Dynamics ERP 軟體授權的銷售和諮詢。它透過打包軟體解決方案、無代碼平台和行動應用程式部門運作。打包軟體解決方案部分是指打包軟體和客製化軟體解決方案。無程式碼平台和行動應用程式專注於透過無程式碼平台提供快速開發環境。該公司由 Kian Hwa Goh、Lay Hua Lung 和 Kim Chwee Chew 於 2023 年 5 月 12 日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Axe Compute, Inc. engages in the provision of graphics processing unit compute capacity for artificial intelligence and other complex computing workloads. It operates through the following segments: Compute Services and Treasury Management segment, and Drug Discovery Services segment. The Compute Services and Treasury Management segment provides services that include access to GPU compute capacity and manage the ATH Treasury Strategy. The Drug Discovery Services segment provides services that include the application of AI, creation of specific 3D culture models used in drug development. The company was founded by Lawrence W. Gadbaw, Peter L. Morawetz, and Jeffrey K. Drogue on April 23, 2002 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Axe Compute, Inc. 致力於為人工智慧和其他複雜運算工作負載提供圖形處理單元運算能力。它透過以下部門運作：計算服務和財務管理部門以及藥物發現服務部門。運算服務和財務管理部門提供的服務包括存取 GPU 運算能力和管理 ATH 財務策略。藥物發現服務部門提供的服務包括人工智慧的應用、藥物開發中使用的特定 3D 文化模型的創建。該公司由 Lawrence W. Gadbaw、Peter L. Morawetz 和 Jeffrey K. Drogue 於 2002 年 4 月 23 日創立，總部位於賓州匹茲堡。

info.description: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of cancer immunotherapies. It focuses on its Amphiphile platform for trafficking lymph nodes. The company was founded by Darrell Irvine in August 2011 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事癌症免疫療法的開發。它專注於其用於運輸淋巴結的 Aphiphile 平台。該公司由 Darrell Irvine 於 2011 年 8 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: CDW Corp. engages in the provision of information technology solutions to small, medium, and large business, government, education, and healthcare customers. It operates through the following segments: Corporate, Small Business, Public, and Other. The Corporate segment serves US private sector business customers with more than 250 employees. The Small Business segment focuses on the US private sector business customers with up to 250 employees. The Public segment includes government agencies and education and healthcare institutions. The Other segment focuses on CDW UK and Canada. The company was founded by Michael P. Krasny in 1984 and is headquartered in Vernon Hills, IL.
info.description_zh: CDW Corp. 致力於為小型、中型和大型企業、政府、教育和醫療保健客戶提供資訊科技解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：企業部門、小型企業部門、公共部門和其他部門。企業部門為美國私人企業客戶提供服務，擁有 250 多名員工。小型企業部門專注於擁有最多 250 名員工的美國私人企業客戶。公共部門包括政府機構以及教育和醫療機構。其他部分則重點關注 CDW 英國和加拿大。該公司由 Michael P. Krasny 於 1984 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州弗農希爾斯。

info.description: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that combines automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and in vivo validation capabilities to discover novel medicines. Its Recursion operating system enables advanced machine learning approaches to reveal drug candidates, mechanisms of action, novel chemistry, and potential toxicity, with the eventual goal of decoding biology and advancing new therapeutics that radically improve people's lives. The company was founded by Blake Borgeson, Christopher C. Gibson, and Dean Y. Li on November 4, 2013 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，結合自動化、人工智慧、機器學習和體內驗證能力來發現新藥。其遞歸操作系統使先進的機器學習方法能夠揭示候選藥物、作用機制、新穎的化學物質和潛在的毒性，最終目標是解碼生物學並推進新的治療方法，從根本上改善人們的生活。該公司由 Blake Borgeson、Christopher C. Gibson 和 Dean Y. Li 於 2013 年 11 月 4 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Transcat, Inc. engages in the provision of calibration and laboratory instrument services. It operates through the following business segments: Service and Distribution. The Service segment offers calibration, repair, inspection, analytical qualifications, preventive maintenance, consulting, and other related services. The Distribution segment distributes professional grade tests, measurement, and control instrumentation. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Rochester, NY.
info.description_zh: Transcat, Inc. 從事提供校準和實驗室儀器服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務和分銷。服務部門提供校準、維修、檢查、分析鑑定、預防性維護、諮詢和其他相關服務。分銷部門分銷專業級測試、測量和控制儀器。該公司成立於 1964 年，總部位於紐約州羅徹斯特。

info.description: TripAdvisor, Inc. is an online travel company, which owns and operates a portfolio of online travel brands. It operates through the following segments: Experiences, Hotels and Other, and TheFork. The Experiences segment includes both Viator and Tripadvisor points of sale. The Hotel and Other segment manages the hotel and restaurant guidance platform. The TheFork segment provides an online marketplace that enables diners to discover and book online reservations. The company was founded by Nicholas Shanny and Stephen Kaufer in February 2000 and is headquartered in Needham, MA.

info.description: Absci Corp. is the drug and target discovery company harnessing deep learning AI and synthetic biology to expand the therapeutic potential of proteins. It partners with pharma and biotech innovators to create the next generation of protein-based drugs. The company was founded by Sean McClain in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Absci Corp. 是一家藥物和標靶發現公司，利用深度學習人工智慧和合成生物學來擴大蛋白質的治療潛力。它與製藥和生物技術創新者合作，創造下一代基於蛋白質的藥物。該公司由 Sean McClain 於 2011 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: Quanterix Corp. engages in the development of ultra-sensitive digital immunoassay platform that advances precision health for life sciences research and diagnostics. Its products and services include Simoa Assay Kits, HD-X analyzer, SR-X Biomarker Detection System, SP-X Imaging and Analysis System, 2470 Arrayer, Simoa Accelerator Laboratory, Uman NF-Light, and Homebrew -Custom Assay Development. The company was founded by Nicholas J. Naclerio and David R. Walt in April 2007 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Quanterix Corp. 致力於開發超靈敏數位免疫分析平台，促進生命科學研究和診斷的精準健康。其產品和服務包括 Simoa 檢測試劑盒、HD-X 分析儀、SR-X 生物標記檢測系統、SP-X 成像和分析系統、2470 陣列儀、Simoa 加速器實驗室、Uman NF-Light 和 Homebrew - 客製化檢測開發。該公司由 Nicholas J. Naclerio 和 David R. Walt 於 2007 年 4 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比勒里卡。

info.description: BCB Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It offers loans, deposit products, and retail and commercial banking services. The company was founded on May 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Bayonne, NJ.
info.description_zh: BCB Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供金融解決方案。它提供貸款、存款產品以及零售和商業銀行服務。該公司成立於2003年5月1日，總部位於新澤西州巴約訥。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Reddit Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 Reddit Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過輸入標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Silvaco Group, Inc. provides technology computer aided design software, electronic data automation software and semiconductor intellectual property. The TCAD, EDA and SIP solutions enable semiconductor and photonics companies to increase productivity, accelerate their product's time to market and reduce their development and manufacturing costs. Its services include SPICE Modeling Services, TCAD Modeling Services, Library Design Services and Library Characterization Services. The company was founded on November 18, 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Silvaco Group, Inc. 提供技術電腦輔助設計軟體、電子資料自動化軟體和半導體智慧財產權。 TCAD、EDA 和 SIP 解決方案使半導體和光子學公司能夠提高生產力、加快產品上市時間並降低開發和製造成本。其服務包括 SPICE 建模服務、TCAD 建模服務、庫設計服務和庫表徵服務。該公司成立於2009年11月18日，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Versus Systems, Inc. engages in the development of business-to-business video game support software. Its software platform allows video game publishers and developers to offer prize based matches. Its geographical segments include Canada and USA. The company's platform facilitates several types of single player prize challenges that includes a range of prize types, including coupons, sweepstakes style prizes, consumer packaged goods and downloadable content. The company was founded by Matthew Pierce on December 1, 1988 and is headquartered in Dover, DE.
info.description_zh: Versus Systems, Inc. 從事企業對企業電玩支援軟體的開發。其軟體平台允許視頻遊戲發行商和開發商提供有獎比賽。其地理部分包括加拿大和美國。該公司的平台支援多種類型的單人獎品挑戰，其中包括一系列獎品類型，包括優惠券、抽獎獎品、消費品和下載內容。該公司由 Matthew Pierce 於 1988 年 12 月 1 日創立，總部位於特拉華州多佛。

info.description: Airship AI Holdings, Inc. engages in a video, sensor, and data management surveillance platform which focuses on the provision of software services. Its products include Airship Acropolis OS, Airship Command, and Airship Outpost. The company was founded by Derek Xu on June 30, 2003 and is headquartered in Redmond, WA.
info.description_zh: Airship AI Holdings, Inc.從事視訊、感測器和資料管理監控平台，專注於提供軟體服務。其產品包括Airship Acropolis OS、Airship Command、Airship Outpost等。該公司由 Derek Xu 於 2003 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州雷德蒙德。

info.description: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the purpose of acquiring and integrating various companies engaged in the aerospace and defense industry. It operates through the following segments: Avionics and Electronics, Electric Air Mobility, Drones, and Training. The Avionics and Electronics segment refers to its brand, Aspen Avionics, which designs, certifies, and manufactures critical navigation, communication, and display components and integrated systems. The Electric Air Mobility segment transforms urban transportation with its development of an electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. The Drones perform crucial missions such as ISR and target tracking, mapping, surveying, inspection, and localization, enhancing military, and commercial operational efficiency worldwide. The Training segment relates to its brand, Coastal Defense, delivers specialized professional training services to the military and commercial aviation communities. The company was founded by Chirinjeev Kathuria on August, 30, 2021 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. 致力於收購和整合從事航空航天和國防工業的多家公司。該公司透過以下部門運作：航空電子和電子部門、電動空中交通部門、無人機部門和培訓部門。航空電子設備和電子部門是指其品牌 Aspen Avionics，該公司設計、認證和製造關鍵的導航、通訊和顯示組件以及整合系統。電動空中交通部門透過開發電動垂直起降 (eVTOL) 飛機改變了城市交通。無人機執行ISR和目標追蹤、測繪、測量、檢查和定位等關鍵任務，提高全球軍事和商業營運效率。培訓部門與其品牌海岸防禦有關，為軍事和商業航空界提供專門的專業培訓服務。該公司由 Chirinjeev Kathuria 於 2021 年 8 月 30 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd. engages in developing, manufacturing, marketing, exporting, and retailing alcoholic and non-alcoholic brands. The company was founded by Meena Beri, Amit Beri and Sahil Beri on April 20, 2018 and is headquartered in Seven Hills, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd. 從事酒精和非酒精品牌的開發、製造、行銷、出口和零售。該公司由 Meena Beri、Amit Beri 和 Sahil Beri 於 2018 年 4 月 20 日創立，總部位於澳洲七山。

info.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a cruise company, which engages in the ownership and operation of the following global cruise brands: Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises, and Silversea Cruises. The firm also holds interest in TUI Cruises GmbH, which operates the German brands TUI Cruises and Hapag-Lloyd Cruises. The company was founded by Arne Wilhelmsen in 1968 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: 皇家加勒比集團是一家郵輪公司，擁有並經營以下全球郵輪品牌：皇家加勒比國際郵輪、精緻郵輪、銀海郵輪。該公司還持有 TUI Cruises GmbH 的股份，該公司經營德國品牌 TUI Cruises 和 Hapag-Lloyd Cruises。該公司由 Arne Wilhelmsen 於 1968 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Ziff Davis, Inc. is a digital media and internet company. The firm's portfolio includes brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and Martech. It operates through the following segments: Technology and Shopping, Gaming and Entertainment, Health and Wellness, Connectivity, and Cybersecurity and Martech. The company was founded by Jaye Muller and John F. Rieley in 1995 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Ziff Davis, Inc. 是一家數位媒體和網路公司。該公司的產品組合包括科技、購物、遊戲和娛樂、連接、健康、網路安全和 Martech 領域的品牌。它透過以下部門運作：科技和購物、遊戲和娛樂、健康和保健、連接、網路安全和行銷技術。該公司由 Jaye Muller 和 John F. Rieley 於 1995 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies that portfolio management believes will contribute to or benefit from artificial intelligence technologies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資組合管理認為將有助於人工智慧技術或受益於人工智慧技術的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calumet, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, formulation, and sale of specialty branded products and renewable fuel. It operates through the following segments: Specialty Products and Solutions, Montana/Renewables, Performance Brands, and Corporate. The Specialty Products & Solutions segment consists of customer-focused solutions and formulation businesses. The Montana/Renewables segment is composed of a Great Falls specialty asphalt facility and Montana Renewables facility. The Performance Brands segment includes Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, and TruFuel. The Corporate segment focuses on the general and administrative expenses not allocated to other segments. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: Calumet, Inc. 從事專業品牌產品和再生燃料的製造、配​​製和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：特種產品和解決方案部門、蒙大拿州/再生能源部門、績效品牌部門和企業部門。特種產品和解決方案部門包括以客戶為中心的解決方案和配方業務。蒙大拿州/再生能源部門由大瀑布特種瀝青設施和蒙大拿州再生能源設施組成。性能品牌部門包括 Royal Purple、Bel-Ray 和 TruFuel。公司部門專注於未分配給其他部門的一般和管理費用。該公司成立於 1919 年，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: Danaher Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of professional, medical, industrial, and commercial products and services. It operates through the following segments: Biotechnology, Life Sciences, and Diagnostics. The Biotechnology segment includes bioprocessing, discovery, and medical businesses and offers a range of tools, consumables, and services. The Life Sciences segment offers a range of instruments and consumables to study the basic building blocks of life, including DNA and RNA. The Diagnostics segment offers clinical instruments, reagents, consumables, software, and services used to diagnose disease and make treatment decisions. The company was founded by Steven M. Rales and Mitchell P. Rales in 1984 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.
info.description_zh: 丹納赫公司從事專業、醫療、工業和商業產品和服務的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：生物技術、生命科學和診斷。生技部門包括生物加工、發現和醫療業務，並提供一系列工具、消耗品和服務。生命科學部門提供一系列儀器和消耗品來研究生命的基本組成部分，包括 DNA 和 RNA。診斷部門提供用於診斷疾病和做出治療決策的臨床儀器、試劑、消耗品、軟體和服務。該公司由 Steven M. Rales 和 Mitchell P. Rales 於 1984 年創立，總部位於華盛頓特區。

info.description: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of advanced sequencing solutions for genetic analysis. It operates through the following geographical segments: America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Stephen Turner and Joseph Vincent Bonventre on July 14, 2000 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. 從事遺傳分析的先進定序解決方案的開發、製造和行銷。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 Stephen Turner 和 Joseph Vincent Bonventre 於 2000 年 7 月 14 日創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Smurfit WestRock Plc engages in the development and provision of packaging solutions. Its products include corrugated packaging, corrugated sheet boards, hexacomb packaging, and solid boards. The company was founded on July 6, 2017 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Smurfit WestRock Plc 從事包裝解決方案的開發和提供。其產品包括瓦楞包裝、瓦楞紙板、六格包裝和實心紙板。該公司成立於2017年7月6日，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Sprott Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Copper Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Copper Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Prenetics Global Ltd. is a health sciences company, which engages in providing consumer health products and services. The firm offers scientifically formulated supplements under the IM8 brand, sports nutrition products under the Europa platform, and direct-to-consumer DNA tests through the CircleDNA brand. It is also involved in establishing a Bitcoin treasury for the exploration of applications within the healthcare ecosystem. The company was founded by Sheng Wu Yeung and Chi Hung Tzang in 2014 and has dual headquartered in Charlotte, the United States and Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Prenetics Global Ltd. 是一家健康科學公司，致力於提供消費者健康產品和服務。該公司在 IM8 品牌下提供科學配製的補充劑，在 Europa 平台下提供運動營養產品，並透過 CircleDNA 品牌提供直接面向消費者的 DNA 測試。它還參與建立比特幣金庫，以探索醫療保健生態系統中的應用程式。該公司由Sheng Wu Yeung和Chi Hung Tzang於2014年創立，雙總部位於美國夏洛特和香港。

info.description: Citigroup, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial products and services. It operates through the following segments: Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, U.S. Personal Banking (USPB), and All Other. The Services segment includes Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) which provides an integrated suite of tailored cash management, trade, and working capital solutions to multinational corporations, financial institutions and public sector organizations, and Securities Services, which offers cross-border support for clients, providing on-the-ground local market expertise, post-trade technologies, customized data solutions, and a wide range of securities services solutions that can be tailored to meet client needs. The Markets segment provides corporate, institutional, and public sector clients around the world with a full range of sales and trading services across equities, foreign exchange, rates, spread products, and commodities. The Banking segment offers Investment Banking and Corporate Lending services. The Wealth segment includes Private Bank, Wealth at Work, and Citigold and provides financial services to a range of client segments through banking, lending, mortgages, investment, custody, and trust product offerings. The USPB segment includes Branded Cards and Retail Services, which have proprietary card portfolios and co-branded card portfolios within Branded Cards, and co-brand and private label relationships within Retail Services. The All Other segment consists of activities not assigned to the reportable operating segments, including certain unallocated costs of global functions, other corporate expenses, and net treasury results. The company was founded in 1812 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 花旗集團是一家控股公司，從事提供金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：服務部門、市場部門、銀行部門、財富部門、美國個人銀行部門 (USPB) 和所有其他部門。服務部門包括資金和貿易解決方案（TTS），為跨國公司、金融機構和公共部門組織提供一整套量身定制的現金管理、貿易和營運資金解決方案；以及證券服務，為客戶提供跨境支持，提供實地本地市場專業知識、交易後技術、定制數據解決方案以及可根據客戶需求定制的廣泛證券服務解決方案。市場部門為世界各地的企業、機構和公共部門客戶提供涵蓋股票、外匯、利率、價差產品和大宗商品的全方位銷售和交易服務。銀行部門提供投資銀行和企業貸款服務。財富部門包括私人銀行、Wealth at Work 和 Citigold，透過銀行、貸款、抵押貸款、投資、託管和信託產品向一系列客戶群提供金融服務。 USPB 部門包括品牌卡和零售服務，其中在品牌卡內擁有專有卡組合和聯合品牌卡組合，以及零售服務內的聯合品牌和自有品牌關係。所有其他部門由未分配給可報告經營部門的活動組成，包括全球職能的某些未分配成本、其他公司費用和淨財務表現。該公司成立於 1812 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: ServiceTitan, Inc. engages in the collection of field service activities required to install, maintain, and service the infrastructure and systems of residences and commercial buildings. The company was founded by Ara Mahdessian and Vahe Kuzoyan on June 8, 2008 and is headquartered in Glendale, CA.
info.description_zh: ServiceTitan, Inc. 從事安裝、維護和維修住宅和商業建築的基礎設施和系統所需的現場服務活動。該公司由 Ara Mahdessian 和 Vahe Kuzoyan 於 2008 年 6 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州格倫代爾。

info.description: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a medicine company, which engages in the provision of pharmaceuticals. Its product portfolio includes generics, specialty, biosciences, and product catalog. It operates through the following segments: Generics, Specialty, and AvKARE. The Generics segment relates to oral solids, powders, liquids, sterile injectables, nasal sprays, inhalation and respiratory products, biosimilar products, ophthalmics, films, and transdermal patches and topicals. The Specialty segment refers to the development, promotion, sale, and distribution of proprietary branded pharmaceutical products. The AvKARE segment provides pharmaceuticals, medical, and surgical products and services to governmental agencies. The company was founded by Chirag K. Patel and Chintu Patel in 2002 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家從事藥品供應的醫藥公司。其產品組合包括仿製藥、特種藥、生物科學和產品目錄。它透過以下部門運作：仿製藥部門、專業部門和 AvKARE 部門。仿製藥部門涉及口服固體、粉末、液體、無菌注射劑、鼻噴劑、吸入和呼吸產品、生物相似藥、眼科、薄膜、透皮貼片和外用藥。特種藥品部門是指專有品牌藥品的開發、推廣、銷售及分銷。 AvKARE 部門向政府機構提供藥物、醫療和外科產品及服務。該公司由 Chirag K. Patel 和 Chintu Patel 於 2002 年創立，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: EVgo, Inc. engages in the provision of electric vehicle charging station services. It offers the EVgo network, home charging solutions, work charging solutions, and freedom station plans to electric car owners. The company was founded in October 2010 and is headquartered in El Segundo, CA.
info.description_zh: EVgo, Inc. 從事提供電動車充電站服務。它為電動車車主提供 EVgo 網路、家庭充電解決方案、工作充電解決方案和自由站計劃。該公司成立於 2010 年 10 月，總部位於加州埃爾塞貢多。

info.description: Agilent Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of application focused solutions for life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets. It operates through the following segments: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets, Applied Markets, and Agilent CrossLab. The Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets segment offers active pharmaceutical ingredients for oligo-based therapeutics as well as solutions that include reagents, instruments, software and consumables. The Applied Markets segment refers to the application-focused solutions that include instruments and software that enable customers to identify, quantify, and analyze the physical and biological properties of substances and products. The Agilent CrossLab segment spans the entire lab with its extensive services and consumables portfolio in addition to software and laboratory automation solutions. The company was founded in May 1999 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: 安捷倫科技公司致力於為生命科學、診斷和應用化學市場提供以應用為中心的解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：生命科學和診斷市場、應用市場和安捷倫 CrossLab。生命科學和診斷市場部門提供基於寡核苷酸的治療的活性藥物成分以及包括試劑、儀器、軟體和消耗品的解決方案。應用市場部門是指以應用為中心的解決方案，包括使客戶能夠識別、量化和分析物質和產品的物理和生物特性的儀器和軟體。安捷倫 CrossLab 部門涵蓋整個實驗室，除了軟體和實驗室自動化解決方案之外，還提供廣泛的服務和耗材組合。該公司成立於 1999 年 5 月，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Invesco KBW Bank ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the KBW Nasdaq Bank Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is a modified-market capitalization-weighted index of companies primarily engaged in U.S. banking activities, as determined by the index provider. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of large national U.S. money centers, regional banks, and thrift institutions that are publicly traded in the U.S. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco KBW Bank ETF 旨在追蹤 KBW 納斯達克銀行指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數是由指數提供者決定的主要從事美國銀行業務的公司的修正市值加權指數。基礎指數旨在追蹤在美國公開交易的大型國家級貨幣中心、地區銀行和儲蓄機構的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Repligen Corp. is a global life sciences company, which engages in providing bioprocessing technologies and solutions used in the process of manufacturing biological drugs. It operates through the North America. Europe, and Asia Pacific Region or Other geographical segments. The company was founded by Alexander G. Rich and Paul R. Schimmel in May 1981 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Repligen Corp.是一家全球生命科學公司，致力於提供生物藥物製造過程中使用的生物加工技術和解決方案。它的業務遍及北美。歐洲、亞太地區或其他地理區域。該公司由 Alexander G. Rich 和 Paul R. Schimmel 於 1981 年 5 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: M&T Bank Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking, trust, wealth management, and investment services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Bank, Retail Bank, Institutional Services and Wealth Management, and All Other. The Commercial Bank segment offers a wide range of credit products and banking services to middle-market and large commercial customers, mainly within the markets served by the company. The Retail Bank segment refers to the services to consumers and small businesses through the company's branch network and several other delivery channels such as telephone banking, internet banking, and ATMs. The Institutional Services and Wealth Management segment relates to helping high net worth individuals, institutions, and families grow, preserve, and transfer wealth. The All Other segment reflects other activities of the company that are not directly attributable to the reported segments. The company was founded on August 30, 1856 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: M&T Bank Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，提供零售和商業銀行、信託、財富管理和投資服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行、零售銀行、機構服務和財富管理以及所有其他部門。商業銀行部門主要在公司服務的市場內向中型市場和大型商業客戶提供廣泛的信貸產品和銀行服務。零售銀行部門是指透過公司的分行網路和電話銀行、網路銀行和自動櫃員機等其他幾種交付管道向消費者和小型企業提供的服務。機構服務和財富管理部門涉及幫助高淨值個人、機構和家庭成長、保存和轉移財富。所有其他部門反映了公司不直接歸屬於報告部門的其他活動。該公司成立於 1856 年 8 月 30 日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: Victoryshares Small Cap Free Cash Flow ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory U.S. Small Cap Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the Index and at least 80% of its assets in equity securities with small market capitalizations. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of U.S. issuers within the Parent Index that have high free cash flow yields.
info.description_zh: Victoryshares 小型股自由現金流 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與 Victory 美國小型股自由現金流指數表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數中的證券以及至少80%的資產投資於小市值的股票證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對母指數內具有高自由現金流收益率的美國發行人的股票證券的投資。

info.description: comScore, Inc. is a global information and analytics company, which engages in the measurement of audiences, consumer behavior, and advertising across media platforms. The company was founded by Magid M. Abraham and Gian Mark Fulgoni in August 1999 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: comScore, Inc. 是一家全球資訊和分析公司，致力於跨媒體平台的受眾、消費者行為和廣告測量。該公司由 Magid M. Abraham 和 Gian Mark Fulgoni 於 1999 年 8 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: SoundThinking, Inc. engages in providing precision-policing and security solutions. It also includes ShotSpotter, SecureCampus, and ShotSpotter SiteSecure solutions. The company was founded by Robert B. Calhoun, Jason Dunham, and Robert Leroy Showen in 1996 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: SoundThinking, Inc. 致力於提供精準警務和安全解決方案。它還包括 ShotSpotter、SecureCampus 和 ShotSpotter SiteSecure 解決方案。該公司由 Robert B. Calhoun、Jason Dunham 和 Robert Leroy Showen 於 1996 年創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. engages in the design, development, and commercialization of products for people with insulin-dependent diabetes. Its products include Tandem Mobi System and t:slim X2 Insulin Pump. The company was founded by Paul M. DiPerna on January 27, 2006 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. 致力於為胰島素依賴型糖尿病患者設計、開發和商業化產品。其產品包括 Tandem Mobi System 和 t:slim X2 胰島素幫浦。該公司由 Paul M. DiPerna 於 2006 年 1 月 27 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: International Paper Co. engages in the business of producing renewable fiber-based packaging and pulp products. It operates through the following segments: Industrial Packaging, Global Cellulose Fibers, and Corporate and Intersegment. The Industrial Packaging segment is involved in the production of fiber-based packaging that protects and promotes goods, enables worldwide commerce, and helps keep consumers safe. The Global Cellulose Fibers segment offers a wide range of applications like diapers, towel and tissue products, feminine care, incontinence, and other personal care products that promote health and wellness. The company was founded by Hugh J. Chisholm in 1898 and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: 國際紙業公司從事生產再生纖維包裝和紙漿產品的業務。它透過以下部門運作：工業包裝部門、全球纖維素纖維部門以及企業和部門間部門。工業包裝部門涉及纖維包裝的生產，以保護和促銷商品，促進全球貿易，並幫助確保消費者安全。全球纖維素纖維領域提供廣泛的應用，如尿布、毛巾和紙巾產品、女性護理、失禁和其他促進健康的個人護理產品。該公司由 Hugh J. Chisholm 於 1898 年創立，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a portfolio of convertible securities, investment grade and below investment grade bonds, loans, equity-linked notes, and floating rate securities. The fund also invests through derivatives such as options. It employs fundamental analysis with a top-down global macroeconomic approach to create its portfolio. Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund was formed on March 11, 2014 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。它主要投資於可轉換證券、投資等級及低於投資等級債券、貸款、股票掛鉤票據和浮動利率證券的投資組合。該基金也透過選擇權等衍生性商品進行投資。它採用基本面分析和自上而下的全球宏觀經濟方法來創建其投資組合。 Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 成立於 2014 年 3 月 11 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Fastenal Co. engages in the distribution of fasteners and tools. It also operates hardware stores. The company was founded by Robert A. Kierlin, Michael M. Gostomski, Henry K. McConnon, John D. Remick, and Stephen M. Slaggie in November 1967 and is headquartered in Winona, MN.
info.description_zh: Fastenal Co. 從事緊固件和工具的分銷。它還經營五金店。該公司由 Robert A. Kierlin、Michael M. Gostomski、Henry K. McConnon、John D. Remick 和 Stephen M. Slaggie 於 1967 年 11 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州威諾納。

info.description: iShares MSCI All Country Asia ex Japan ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI AC Asia ex Japan Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure equity market performance of securities from the following 10 developed and emerging market countries or regions: China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Thailand.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI All Country Asia（日本除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI AC Asia（日本除外）指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通市值指數，旨在衡量以下 10 個已開發和新興市場國家或地區證券的股票市場表現：中國、香港、印度、印尼、馬來西亞、菲律賓、新加坡、韓國、台灣和泰國。

info.description: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions U.S. Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in U.S.-listed equity securities of companies that, in the Sub-Adviser's opinion, are primarily focused on building solutions to address climate change. It may invest in international companies, including those in emerging markets, through U.S. exchange-tradedADRs, however, they will not be considered U.S. equity securities for purposes of the fund's 80% policy.
info.description_zh: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions 美國股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過主要投資於美國上市公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，副顧問認為這些公司主要致力於建立應對氣候變遷的解決方案。它可以透過美國交易所交易的美國存託憑證投資於國際公司，包括新興市場的公司，但是，就該基金的 80% 政策而言，它們不會被視為美國股票證券。

info.description: Harvard Bioscience, Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells technologies, products and services that enable fundamental research, discovery, and pre-clinical testing for drug development. It operates under the geographical segments: United States, Germany, China, United Kingdom, and Rest of the World. It sells its products through catalog, Website, distributors, and direct sales force. The company was founded by Dr. William T. Porter in 1901 and is headquartered in Holliston, MA.
info.description_zh: 哈佛生物科學公司開發、製造和銷售技術、產品和服務，為藥物開發的基礎研究、發現和臨床前測試提供支援。它在以下地理區域運作：美國、德國、中國、英國和世界其他地區。它透過目錄、網站、分銷商和直銷隊伍銷售其產品。該公司由 William T. Porter 博士於 1901 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州霍利斯頓。

info.description: Workday, Inc. engages in the provision of development of enterprise cloud applications for finance and human resources. It delivers financial management, human capital management and analytics applications designed for companies, educational institutions, and government agencies. The company was founded by David A. Duffield and Aneel Bhusri in 2005 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.

info.description: Barrett Business Services, Inc. engages in the provision of business management solutions for small and mid-sized companies. It develops a management platform that integrates a knowledge-based approach from the management consulting industry with tools from the human resource outsourcing industry. It focuses on professional employers and staffing and recruiting services. The company was founded in July 1965 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Barrett Business Services, Inc. 致力於為中小型公司提供業務管理解決方案。它開發了一個管理平台，將管理諮詢行業的知識方法與人力資源外包行業的工具整合在一起。它專注於專業雇主以及人員配備和招聘服務。該公司成立於 1965 年 7 月，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場擴展 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a gene editing company, which engages in the development of transformative gene-based medicines for serious diseases using its proprietary CRISPR/Cas9 platform. Its CRISPR/Cas9 platform is a gene editing technology that allows for precise, directed changes to genomic DNA. The firm offers a portfolio of therapeutic programs across a broad range of disease areas including hemoglobinopathies, oncology, regenerative medicine, and rare diseases. The company was founded by Rodger Novak, Emmanuelle Charpentier, Shaun Patrick Foy, Matthew Porteus, Daniel Anderson, Chad Cowan, and Craig Mellow on October 31, 2013 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: CRISPR Therapeutics AG 是一家基因編輯公司，利用其專有的 CRISPR/Cas9 平台開發針對嚴重疾病的轉化基因藥物。其 CRISPR/Cas9 平台是一種基因編輯技術，可對基因組 DNA 進行精確、定向的改變。該公司提供涵蓋廣泛疾病領域的治療項目組合，包括血紅蛋白病、腫瘤學、再生醫學和罕見疾病。該公司由 Rodger Novak、Emmanuelle Charpentier、Shaun Patrick Foy、Matthew Porteus、Daniel Anderson、Chad Cowan 和 Craig Mellow 於 2013 年 10 月 31 日創立，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of sports and entertainment. It operates through the following segments: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), and IMG. The UFC segment refers to a global sports brand and media content company. The WWE segment is involved in media organizations and global leaders in sports entertainment. The IMG segment manages the operations of the IMG business and on location. The company was founded on March 29, 2023 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. 從事提供體育和娛樂業務。它透過以下部門運作：終極格鬥錦標賽 (UFC)、世界摔角娛樂 (WWE) 和 IMG。 UFC 部門是指一家全球運動品牌和媒體內容公司。 WWE 部門涉及媒體組織和體育娛樂的全球領導者。 IMG 部門管理 IMG 業務和現場營運。該公司成立於2023年3月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Adeia, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the invention, development, and licensing of innovations and technologies for entertainment, media, consumer electronics, and semiconductor industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Asia, Canada, Europe and Middle East, and Other. The company was founded on October 1, 2022 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

info.description_zh: Adeia, Inc. 是一家科技公司，致力於娛樂、媒體、消費性電子和半導體產業的創新和技術的發明、開發和授權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、亞洲、加拿大、歐洲和中東等。該公司成立於2022年10月1日，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Shopify, Inc. is a global commerce company that provides essential internet infrastructure for commerce, offering trusted tools to start, scale, market, and run a retail business of any size. The Company's software enables merchants to run their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts and marketplaces. The Shopify platform provides merchants with a single view of their business across all of their sales channels and enables them to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics and reporting and access financing, all from one integrated back office. The company was founded on September 28, 2004 and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.
info.description_zh: Shopify, Inc. 是一家全球商業公司，為商業提供必要的網路基礎設施，並提供值得信賴的工具來啟動、擴展、行銷和經營任何規模的零售業務。該公司的軟體使商家能夠在所有銷售管道上開展業務，包括網路和行動店面、實體零售店、社交媒體店面和市場。 Shopify 平台為商家提供了跨所有銷售管道的單一業務視圖，使他們能夠管理產品和庫存、處理訂單和付款、履行和發貨訂單、建立客戶關係、採購產品、利用分析和報告以及獲取融資，所有這些都透過一個整合後台進行。該公司成立於2004年9月28日，總部位於加拿大渥太華。

info.description: Honeytree U.S. Equity ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation achieved primarily through investing in responsibly growing companies. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") sub-advised by Honeytree Investment Management Ltd. (the "Sub-Adviser"). The fund does not seek to replicate the performance of a specified index. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes in a concentrated portfolio of large-cap and mid-cap U.S. listed equity stocks.
info.description_zh: Honeytree 美國股票 ETF 尋求主要透過投資負責任成長的公司來實現資本增值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 Honeytree Investment Management Ltd.（「副顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金並未尋求複製特定指數的表現。該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於美國上市大盤股和中盤股的集中投資組合來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2035 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2035 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Invesco Indexing LLC compiles and maintains the underlying index. The index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2035. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2035 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2035 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。 Invesco Indexing LLC 嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制和維護基礎指數。該指數旨在衡量 2035 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Strattec Security Corp. is a global automotive access company that designs and delivers safe, secure, and highly engineered access solutions for the automotive and mobility industries. The firm offers vehicle access solutions, security and authorization solutions, user interface controls solutions, dealer direct fulfillment services, aftermarket solutions, and bolt. The company was founded on February 27, 1995 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, WI.
info.description_zh: Strattec Security Corp. 是一家全球汽車門禁公司，為汽車和行動產業設計並提供安全可靠且高度工程化的門禁解決方案。該公司提供車輛存取解決方案、安全性和授權解決方案、使用者介面控制解決方案、經銷商直接履行服務、售後解決方案和螺栓。該公司成立於1995年2月27日，總部位於威斯康辛州密爾瓦基。

info.description: United Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and retail banking. It provides accepting demand, savings and time deposits and granting commercial, real estate, and consumer loans. The company was founded on July 8, 1983 and is headquartered in Martins Ferry, OH.
info.description_zh: United Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事商業和零售銀行業務。它提供接受活期存款、儲蓄存款和定期存款，並發放商業、房地產和消費貸款。該公司成立於 1983 年 7 月 8 日，總部位於俄亥俄州馬丁斯費裡。

info.description: Fidelity D&D Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial and Industrial, Commercial Real Estate, Consumer, and Residential Real Estate. The Commercial and Industrial segment refers to identified historic and the projected cash flows of the borrower and secondarily to the underlying collateral provided by the borrower. The Commercial Real Estate segment offers loans to finance the purchase of real estate, refinance existing obligations, and/or to provide capital. The Consumer segment includes home equity installment loans and lines of credit. The Residential Real Estate segment operates as a secured first lien position of the borrower's residential real estate. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Dunmore, PA.
info.description_zh: Fidelity D&D Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供商業銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業和工業、商業房地產、消費者和住宅房地產。商業和工業部分是指借款人已確定的歷史和預計現金流量，其次是藉款人提供的基礎抵押品。商業房地產部門提供貸款，為購買房地產提供資金、為現有債務再融資和/或提供資本。消費者部門包括房屋淨值分期貸款和信貸額度。住宅房地產部門作為借款人住宅房地產的有擔保第一留置權進行運作。該公司成立於 1902 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州鄧莫爾。

info.description: Weyerhaeuser Co. engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of forest products. It operates through the following segments: Timberlands, Real Estate, Energy, and Natural Resources (Real Estate and ENR), and Wood Products. The Timberlands segment manages private commercial forestland worldwide and engages in growing and harvesting trees for lumber, building, pulp, paper, and other wood products. The Real Estate and ENR segment delivers premiums to timber value by identifying and monetizing higher and better use of lands and capturing the full value of surface and subsurface assets. The Wood Products segment delivers lumber, structural panels, engineered wood products and complementary building products for residential, multi-family, industrial, and light commercial applications. The company was founded by Frederick T. Weyerhaeuser on January 18, 1900 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Weyerhaeuser Co. 從事林產品的製造、分銷和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：Timberlands、房地產、能源和自然資源（房地產和 ENR）以及木製品部門。 Timberlands 部門管理全球私人商業林地，並從事種植和採伐樹木以獲取木材、建築、紙漿、紙張和其他木製品。房地產和 ENR 部門透過識別和貨幣化更高更好的土地利用以及獲取地表和地下資產的全部價值，為木材價值提供溢價。木製品部門為住宅、多戶住宅、工業和輕型商業應用提供木材、結構板、工程木製品和補充建築產品。該公司由 Frederick T. Weyerhaeuser 於 1900 年 1 月 18 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: First Trust Managed Municipal ETF seeks to generate current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and its secondary objective is long term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in municipal debt securities that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income taxes.
info.description_zh: First Trust 管理的市政 ETF 尋求產生免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，其次要目標是長期資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於支付免繳常規聯邦所得稅的利息的市政債務證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Applied Finance IVS US SMID ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of U.S. small to mid ("SMID") capitalization companies. The fund is actively managed and does not seek to replicate an index. The Adviser anticipates generally holding at least 150 different positions in the fund's portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Applied Finance IVS US SMID ETF 尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於美國中小型（「SMID」）資本公司的股本證券。該基金採用主動管理方式，不尋求複製指數。顧問預計通常在基金投資組合中持有至少 150 個不同的部位。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: argenx SE is a global immunology company, which engages in improving the lives of people suffering from severe autoimmune diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Japan, EMEA, and China. The company was founded by Hans J. W. de Haard, Torsten Dreier, and Tim van Hauwermeiren in 2008 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: argenx SE 是一家全球免疫學公司，致力於改善患有嚴重自體免疫疾病的人們的生活。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、日本、歐洲、中東和非洲地區和中國。該公司由 Hans J. W. de Haard、Torsten Dreier 和 Tim van Hauwermeiren 於 2008 年創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: VanEck Biotech ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Biotech 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The Biotech Index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the biotechnology industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Biotech ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 美國上市生物科技 25 指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。生技指數包括美國交易所上市公司生技產業的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: IPG Photonics Corp. engages in the provision of design, development, production and distribution of fiber lasers, laser systems, fiber amplifiers, and related optical components. Its products include lasers, beam delivery, medical, telecom equipment, product finder and components such as pump diodes, chillers, and mid-IR crystals. The company was founded by Valentin P. Gapontsev and Igor Samartsev in 1990 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: IPG Photonics Corp. 從事光纖雷射、雷射系統、光纖放大器和相關光學元件的設計、開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括雷射、光束傳輸、醫療、電信設備、產品查找器以及泵浦二極體、冷卻器和中紅外線晶體等組件。該公司由 Valentin P. Gapontsev 和 Igor Samartsev 於 1990 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: First Trust California Municipal High Income ETF seeks to provide current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and California income taxes, and its secondary objective is long-term capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in municipal debt securities that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and California income taxes. It will invest no more than 50% of its net assets in Municipal Securities that are, at the time of investment, not investment grade, commonly referred to as "high yield" or "junk" bonds.
info.description_zh: First Trust加州市政高收入ETF尋求提供免繳常規聯邦所得稅和加州所得稅的當期收入，其次要目標是長期資本增值。該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於市政債券來實現其投資目標，這些債券支付的利息免徵常規聯邦所得稅和加州所得稅。它將不超過 50% 的淨資產投資於市政證券，這些證券在投資時屬於非投資等級債券，通常被稱為「高收益」或「垃圾」債券。

info.description: Manhattan Associates, Inc. engages in the business of developing, selling, deploying, servicing, and maintaining software solutions designed to manage supply chains, inventory, and omnichannel operations for retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers, logistics providers, and other organizations. It operates through the following geographical segments: North and Latin America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Deepak Raghavan in October 1990 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 曼哈頓聯合公司 (Manhattan Associates, Inc.) 從事開發、銷售、部署、服務和維護軟體解決方案的業務，這些解決方案旨在為零售商、批發商、製造商、物流提供者和其他組織管理供應鏈、庫存和全通路營運。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美和拉丁美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 Deepak Raghavan 於 1990 年 10 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2034. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco Bulletshares 市政債券 2034 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2034 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Mid Cap Value AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Mid Cap Value Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select value stocks from the NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 中型價值 AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 中型價值指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇價值股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: iShares Fallen Angels USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg US High Yield Fallen Angel 3% Capped Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade.
info.description_zh: iShares Fallen Angels 美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國高收益 Fallen Angel 3% 上限指數的投資結果，該指數由先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數旨在反映先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債的表現。

info.description: Beam Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the establishment of integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. Its pipeline includes BEAM-101, BEAM-302, Engineered Stem Cell Antibody Paired Evasion (ESCAPE), BEAM-301, and BEAM-201. The company was founded by David R. Liu, Feng Zhang, Alexis Komor, Nicole Gaudelli, and J. Keith Joung on January 25, 2017 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Beam Therapeutics, Inc.是一家致力於精準基因藥物綜合平台建置的生物科技公司。其管道包括BEAM-101、BEAM-302、工程幹細胞抗體配對規避（ESCAPE）、BEAM-301和BEAM-201。該公司由 David R. Liu、Feng Zhang、Alexis Komor、Nicole Gaudelli 和 J. Keith Joung 於 2017 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Opportunities ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to maximize total return through high current income exempt from federal income tax and capital appreciation. The strategy utilizes fundamental credit research to identify undervalued sectors and securities within the municipal market, maintaining the flexibility to invest across all maturities and credit qualities.
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政機會 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，旨在透過免除聯邦所得稅和資本增值的高流動收入來最大化總回報。該策略利用基礎信用研究來識別市政市場內被低估的行業和證券，保持在所有期限和信用品質下進行投資的靈活性。

info.description: Landmark Bancorp, Inc. /Kansas/ is a holding company. The firm engages in the provision of financial and banking services. It offers checking accounts, savings and investments, loans, online and mobile, business checking and business services. The company was founded on April 22, 1885 and is headquartered in Manhattan, KS.
info.description_zh: Landmark Ba​​rcorp, Inc. /堪薩斯州/是一家控股公司。該公司從事提供金融和銀行服務。它提供支票帳戶、儲蓄和投資、貸款、線上和行動、商業支票和商業服務。該公司成立於 1885 年 4 月 22 日，總部位於堪薩斯州曼哈頓。

info.description: Air T, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of overnight air freight service to the express delivery industry, manufactures and sells aircraft deicers and other industrial equipment, and provides ground support equipment and facilities maintenance to airlines. It operates through the following segments: Overnight Air Cargo, Ground Equipment Sales, Ground Support Services, Printing Equipment & Maintenance, Commercial Aircrafts Engines & Parts, Printing Equipment & Maintenance and Corporate & Other. The Overnight Air Cargo segment operates in the air express delivery services industry. The Ground Equipment Sales segment manufactures and provides mobile deicers and other specialized equipment products to passenger and cargo airlines, airports, the military and industrial customers. The Ground Support Services segment offers ground support equipment maintenance and facilities maintenance services to domestic airlines and aviation service providers. The Commercial Aircrafts, Engines & Parts segment manages and leases aviation assets, supplies surplus and aftermarket commercial jet engine components, provides commercial aircraft disassembly, part-out services, and commercial aircraft parts sales. The Printing Equipment & Maintenance segment designs, manufactures, and sells advanced digital print production equipment and provides maintenance services to commercial customers. The Corporate & Other segment acts as the capital allocator and resource for other segments. The company was founded on November 17, 1980 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Air T, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事向快遞行業提供隔夜航空貨運服務，製造和銷售飛機除冰器和其他工業設備，並向航空公司提供地面支援設備和設施維護。該公司透過以下部門運作：隔夜航空貨運部門、地面設備銷售部門、地面支援服務部門、列印設備及維修部門、商用飛機引擎及零件部門、列印設備及維修部門以及企業及其他部門。隔夜航空貨運部門從事航空快遞服務業。地面設備銷售部門為客運和貨運航空公司、機場、軍事和工業客戶製造和提供行動除冰器和其他專用設備產品。地面保障服務部門為國內航空公司和航空服務提供者提供地面保障設備維護和設施維護服務。商用飛機、發動機和零件部門管理和租賃航空資產，供應剩餘和售後商用噴射發動機零件，提供商用飛機拆解、拆解服務以及商用飛機零件銷售。印刷設備及維修部門設計、製造及銷售先進的數位印刷生產設備，並為商業客戶提供維修服務。公司及其他部門充當其他部門的資本分配者和資源。該公司成立於1980年11月17日，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2032 (collectively, "2032 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2032 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2032 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: abrdn Emerging Markets Dividend Active ETF seeks total return consisting of income and long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging market companies that pay dividend income. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks but may also invest in other types of equity securities, including, but not limited to, preferred stock and depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: abrdn 新興市場股息主動 ETF 尋求由收入和長期資本增值組成的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產價值以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於支付股息收入的新興市場公司的股本證券。該基金將主要投資於普通股，但也可能投資於其他類型的股本證券，包括但不限於優先股和存託憑證。

info.description: The BeeHive ETF seeks capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund primarily invests in equity securities of domestic companies with large and mid-sized market capitalizations. Equity securities in which the fund invests on a principal basis include common stock and sponsored and unsponsored American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). The fund may also invest in foreign securities and equity securities of domestic companies with small market capitalizations.
info.description_zh: BeeHive ETF 尋求資本增值。在正常市場情況下，該基金主要投資於境內大中型市值公司的股票型證券。本基金主要投資的股本證券包括普通股以及保薦和非保薦美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。該基金亦可投資於外國證券及國內小市值公司的股本證券。

info.description: Vulcan Materials Co. engages in the production of construction aggregates. It operates through the following segments: Aggregates, Asphalt, and Concrete. The Aggregates segment produces and sells aggregates and related products and services. The Asphalt segment relates to the production and selling of asphalt mix in Arizona, California, New Mexico, Tennessee, and Texas. The Concrete segment refers to the production and selling of ready-mixed concrete in California, Maryland, and Virginia in addition to the U.S. Virgin Islands and Washington D.C. The company was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: Vulcan Materials Co. 從事建築骨材生產。它透過以下部分運作：骨料、瀝青和混凝土。骨材部門生產和銷售骨材及相關產品和服務。瀝青部門涉及亞利桑那州、加利福尼亞州、新墨西哥州、田納西州和德克薩斯州的瀝青混合料的生產和銷售。混凝土部門是指在加利福尼亞州、馬裡蘭州和維吉尼亞州以及美屬維京群島和華盛頓特區生產和銷售預拌混凝土。該公司成立於 1909 年，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: Eaton Vance Short Duration Income ETF seeks above-average total return over a market cycle of three to five years. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by primarily investing in a diversified portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated fixed income securities of varying maturities consistent with ordinarily seeking to maintain an average duration of approximately three years or less. The fund invests primarily in U.S. government securities, corporate bonds and mortgage- and asset-backed securities.
info.description_zh: 伊頓萬斯短期收益 ETF 尋求在三到五年的市場週期內高於平均的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過主要投資於不同期限的以美元計價的固定收益證券的多元化投資組合來實現其投資目標，並通常尋求保持約三年或更短的平均久期。該基金主要投資於美國政府證券、公司債以及抵押貸款和資產支持證券。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2029 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2029, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2029 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2029年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It offers checking accounts, business savings accounts, online and mobile banking, insurance, and investment advisory services, borrowing, and treasury management. Its customers include sole proprietors, small and medium-sized businesses, partnerships, corporations, non-profit organizations and associations, and investors living and working in and near the bank's primary service area. The company was founded on October 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。它提供支票帳戶、企業儲蓄帳戶、線上和行動銀行、保險、投資諮詢服務、借款和資金管理。其客戶包括獨資經營者、中小型企業、合夥企業、公司、非營利組織和協會，以及在銀行主要服務區域內和附近生活和工作的投資者。該公司成立於1997年10月28日，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Ishares Copper And Metals Mining ETF seeks to track the investment results of the STOXX Global Copper and Metals Mining Index composed of U.S. and non-U.S. equities of companies primarily engaged in copper and metal ore mining. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares 銅和金屬礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球銅和金屬礦業指數的投資結果，該指數由主要從事銅和金屬礦石開採的公司的美國和非美國股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares 1-5 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE BofA 1-5 Year US Corporate Index. The index measures the performance of investment-grade corporate bonds of both U.S. and non-U.S. issuers that are U.S. dollar-denominated and publicly issued in the U.S. domestic market and have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to one year and less than five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 1-5 年投資等級企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE BofA 1-5 年期美國企業指數的投資結果。該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人以美元計價並在美國國內市場公開發行、剩餘期限大於或等於一年且少於五年的投資等級公司債的表現。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於該基金跟踪該指數的標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。

info.description: iShares 0-5 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Markit iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade 0-5 Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds with remaining maturities of less than five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade corporate debt.
info.description_zh: iShares 0-5 年投資等級公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 Markit iBoxx 美元流動投資等級 0-5 指數的投資結果，該指數由以美元計價、剩餘期限少於五年的投資等級公司債組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。该指数旨在反映以美元计价的投资级公司债务的表现。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2029. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2029.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2029 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Hub Group, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive transportation and logistics management services focused on reliability, visibility, and value for customers. It operates through the Intermodal and Transportation Solutions (ITS) and Logistics segments. The ITS segment includes intermodal and dedicated trucking. The Logistics segment focuses on full outsource logistics solutions, transportation management services, consolidation and fulfillment services, and final mile delivery services. The company was founded by Phillip C. Yeager in 1971 and is headquartered in Oak Brook, IL.
info.description_zh: Hub Group, Inc. 致力於提供全面的運輸和物流管理服務，專注於為客戶提供可靠性、可見度和價值。它透過聯運和運輸解決方案（ITS）和物流部門運作。 ITS 部分包括聯運和專用卡車運輸。物流部門專注於全面外包物流解決方案、運輸管理服務、整合和履行服務以及最後一哩交付服務。該公司由 Phillip C. Yeager 於 1971 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州奧克布魯克。

info.description: Cintas Corp. engages in the provision of corporate identity uniforms through rental and sales programs. It operates through the following segments: Uniform Rental and Facility Services, First Aid and Safety Services, and All Other. The Uniform Rental and Facility Services segment consists of the rental and servicing of uniforms and other garments including flame resistant clothing, mats, mops and shop towels, and other ancillary items. The First Aid and Safety Services segment includes first aid and safety products and services. The All Other segment contains fire protection services and its direct sale business. The company was founded by Richard T. Farmer in 1968 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Cintas Corp. 透過租賃和銷售計劃提供企業形象制服。它透過以下部門運作：制服租賃和設施服務部門、急救和安全服務部門以及所有其他部門。制服租賃和設施服務部門包括制服和其他服裝的租賃和服務，包括阻燃服裝、墊子、拖把和抹布以及其他輔助物品。急救和安全服務部門包括急救和安全產品和服務。所有其他部門包括消防服務及其直銷業務。該公司由 Richard T. Farmer 於 1968 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: PACCAR, Inc. is a global technology company, which engages in the design and manufacture of light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks. It operates through the following segments: Truck, Parts, and Financial Services. The Truck segment designs and manufactures heavy, medium, and light duty diesel trucks which are marketed under the Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF brands. The Parts segment distributes aftermarket parts for trucks and related commercial vehicles. The Financial Services segment provides finance and leasing products and services provided to truck customers and dealers. The company was founded by William Pigott Sr. in 1905 and is headquartered in Bellevue, WA.
info.description_zh: PACCAR, Inc.是一家全球科技公司，從事輕型、中型和重型卡車的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：卡車部門、零件部門和金融服務部門。卡車部門設計和製造重型、中型和輕型柴油卡車，並以 Kenworth、Peterbilt 和 DAF 品牌銷售。零件部門分銷卡車和相關商用車的售後零件。金融服務部門為卡車客戶和經銷商提供融資和租賃產品及服務。該公司由 William Pigott Sr. 於 1905 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州貝爾維尤。

info.description: Abbott Laboratories engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of healthcare products. It operates through the following segments: Established Pharmaceutical Products, Diagnostic Products, Nutritional Products, and Medical Devices. The Established Pharmaceutical Products segment refers to the line of branded generic pharmaceuticals manufactured worldwide and marketed and sold outside the United States in emerging markets. The Diagnostic Products segment markets diagnostic systems and tests for blood banks, hospitals, commercial laboratories, clinics, physicians' offices, retailers, government agencies, and alternate care testing sites. The Nutritional Products segment caters to the worldwide sales of pediatric and adult nutritional products. The Medical Devices segment includes a broad line of rhythm management, electrophysiology, heart failure, vascular and structural heart devices for the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, and diabetes care and continuous glucose monitoring products, as well as neuromodulation devices for the management of chronic pain and movement disorders. The company was founded by Wallace Calvin Abbott in 1888 and is headquartered in Abbott Park, IL.
info.description_zh: 雅培實驗室從事醫療保健產品的發現、開發、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：成熟的藥品部門、診斷產品部門、營養產品部門和醫療器材部門。老牌藥品部門是指在全球範圍內生產並在美國境外的新興市場營銷和銷售的品牌仿製藥系列。診斷產品部門為血庫、醫院、商業實驗室、診所、醫生辦公室、零售商、政府機構和替代護理測試場所銷售診斷系統和測試。營養產品部門滿足兒科和成人營養產品的全球銷售需求。醫療器材部門包括廣泛的節律管理、電生理學、心臟衰竭、用於治療心血管疾病的血管和結構性心臟設備、糖尿病護理和連續血糖監測產品，以及用於治療慢性疼痛和運動障礙的神經調節設備。該公司由 Wallace Calvin Abbott 於 1888 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州雅培公園。

info.description: Bank of America Corp. is a bank and financial holding company, which engages in the provision of banking and nonbank financial services. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth and Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, Global Markets, and All Other. The Consumer Banking segment offers credit, banking, and investment products and services to consumers and small businesses. The GWIM segment focuses on solutions to meet clients' needs through a full set of investment management, brokerage, banking, and retirement products. The Global Banking segment deals with lending-related products and services, integrated working capital management and treasury solutions to clients, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment includes sales and trading services, as well as research, to institutional clients across fixed-income, credit, currency, commodity, and equity businesses. The All Other segment consists of asset and liability management activities, equity investments, non-core mortgage loans and servicing activities, the net impact of periodic revisions to the mortgage servicing rights valuation model for both core and non-core MSRs, other liquidating businesses, residual expense allocations and other. The company was founded by Amadeo Peter Giannini in 1904 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: 美國銀行公司是一家銀行和金融控股公司，從事提供銀行和非銀行金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行部門、全球財富與投資管理部門 (GWIM)、全球銀行部門、全球市場部門和所有其他部門。消費者銀行業務部門為消費者及小型企業提供信貸、銀行及投資產品及服務。 GWIM 部門專注於透過全套投資管理、經紀、銀行和退休產品來滿足客戶需求的解決方案。全球銀行業務部門提供貸款相關產品和服務、綜合營運資金管理和客戶資金解決方案以及承銷和諮詢服務。全球市場部門包括向固定收益、信貸、貨幣、商品和股票業務的機構客戶提供銷售和交易服務以及研究。所有其他部門包括資產和負債管理活動、股權投資、非核心抵押貸款和服務活動、核心和非核心抵押貸款服務權估值模型定期修訂的淨影響、其他清算業務、剩餘費用分配等。該公司由 Amadeo Peter Giannini 於 1904 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Medical segments. The Pharmaceutical segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products. The Medical segment manufactures, sources and distributes Cardinal Health branded medical, surgical, and laboratory products. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和醫療部門運作。製藥部門分銷品牌藥品和仿製藥、特殊藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。醫療部門生產、採購和分銷康德樂品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the following segments: Retail Banking, Corporate and Institutional Banking, Asset Management Group, and Other. The Retail Banking segment offers deposit, lending, brokerage, investment management, and cash management products and services to consumer and small business customers. The Corporate and Institutional segment covers the lending, treasury management, and capital markets-related products and services to mid-sized and large corporations, government, and not-for-profit entities. The Asset Management Group segment includes personal wealth management for high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients and institutional asset management. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：零售銀行部門、企業和機構銀行部門、資產管理部門和其他部門。零售銀行部門為消費者和小型企業客戶提供存款、貸款、經紀、投資管理和現金管理產品和服務。企業和機構部門涵蓋向大中型企業、政府和非營利實體提供貸款、資金管理以及資本市場相關產品和服務。資產管理集團業務包括針對高淨值和超高淨值客戶的個人財富管理以及機構資產管理。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: Regions Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in providing consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. It operates through the following segments: Corporate Bank, Consumer Bank, Wealth Management, and Other. The Corporate Bank segment represents the commercial banking functions including commercial and industrial, commercial real estate, and investor real estate lending. The Consumer Bank segment holds the branch network, including consumer banking products and services related to residential first mortgages, home equity lines and loans, small business loans, indirect loans, consumer credit cards, and other consumer loans. The Wealth Management segment offers individuals, businesses, governmental institutions and non-profit entities a range of solutions to help protect, grow and transfer wealth. The Other segment includes its treasury function, the securities portfolio, wholesale funding activities, interest rate risk management activities, and other corporate functions that are not related to a strategic business unit. The company was founded on June 26, 1970 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: Regions Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供消費者和商業銀行業務、財富管理以及抵押貸款產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：企業銀行、消費者銀行、財富管理和其他部門。企業銀行部門代表商業銀行職能，包括商業和工業、商業房地產和投資者房地產貸款。消費者銀行部門擁有分行網絡，包括與住宅第一抵押貸款、房屋淨值額度和貸款、小型企業貸款、間接貸款、消費信用卡和其他消費貸款相關的消費銀行產品和服務。財富管理部門為個人、企業、政府機構和非營利實體提供一系列解決方案，協助保護、成長和轉移財富。其他部門包括其財務職能、證券投資組合、批發融資活動、利率風險管理活動以及與策略業務部門無關的其他公司職能。該公司成立於 1970 年 6 月 26 日，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: TE Connectivity Plc is a company that engages in the provision of connectivity and sensor solutions for the purpose of distribution of power, signal, and data. It operates under the following segments: Transportation Solutions, Industrial Solutions, and Communications Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, sensors, relays, antennas, and application tooling. The Industrial Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, interventional medical components, relays, heat shrink tubing, and wire and cable. The Communications Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, antennas, and heat shrink tubing. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Galway, Ireland.
info.description_zh: TE Con​​nectivity Plc 是一家致力於提供用於電力、訊號和資料分配的連接和感測器解決方案的公司。它的業務分為以下幾個部門：運輸解決方案、工業解決方案和通訊解決方案。運輸解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、感測器、繼電器、天線和應用工具。工業解決方案部門包括端子和連接器系統及組件、介入醫療組件、繼電器、熱縮管以及電線和電纜。通訊解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、天線和熱縮管。該公司成立於2007年，總部位於愛爾蘭戈爾韋。

info.description: ProFrac Holding Corp. engages in the provision of hydraulic fracturing, proppant production, and other completion services. It operates through the following segments: Stimulation Services, Proppant Production, Manufacturing, and Other. The Stimulation Services segment owns a fleet of mobile hydraulic fracturing units and other auxiliary equipment that generates revenue by providing stimulation services to customers. The Proppant Production segment focuses on the provision of proppant to oilfield service providers and exploration and production companies. The Manufacturing segment is involved in the sale of products such as horsepower pumps, valves, piping, swivels, large-bore manifold systems, and fluid ends. The Other segment refers to Flotek Industries and Livewire Power, LLC. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Willow Park, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: ProFrac Holding Corp. 從事提供水力壓裂、支撐劑生產和其他完井服務。它透過以下部門運作：增產服務部門、支撐劑生產部門、製造部門和其他部門。增產服務部門擁有一批行動水力壓裂裝置和其他輔助設備，透過向客戶提供增產服務來創造收入。支撐劑生產部門專注於向油田服務提供者以及勘探和生產公司提供支撐劑。製造部門從事馬力幫浦、閥門、管路、旋轉接頭、大口徑歧管系統和流體端等產品的銷售。其他部門是指 Flotek Industries 和 Livewire Power, LLC。該公司成立於 2016 年，總部位於德克薩斯州威洛帕克。
